description: BDDA* is A* over sets of states stored as BDDs (*binary decision diagrams*). The heuristic is a partition of the states into one BDD per value `h`, so one intersection evaluates it on a whole set. Open sets are expanded by smallest `g + h`, ties to the larger `g`, and a state is opened again only when it is found at a lower cost. So the plan is cheapest whenever the heuristic is *admissible* (it never overestimates), and states that the heuristic marks as dead ends are dropped. With the blind heuristic `h = 0`, BDDA* is symbolic Dijkstra.
